entries.title: Inline tone mapping and the colour space conversion only apply when rendering to the screen
entries.todo: With an EffectComposer the picture loses its tone mapping and sRGB output: add an OutputPass as the last pass.

entries.title: OutputPass takes no parameters
entries.todo: new OutputPass(); it reads tone mapping and colour space from the renderer.
